Ask ELI is its chat: questions about the open document, and agents that change it (Revise, Respond, Address Comments, Draft Document), always as tracked changes you approve first. ELI runs inside Word through Script Lab; "ELI OS" is that snippet, and the tools update themselves from the ELI library.
Who looks after ELI: The ELI team: the admins named in ELI OS Update's notice. Forge reads and explains; it changes nothing without the user choosing it, and never touches the document.

TOOLS (everyone has these; 'tile' = on the dashboard):
- Agreement at a Glance: Key-terms snapshot of the open agreement: parties, term, fees, liability, and type-specific terms. Editable, with jump-to-clause.
- Ask ELI: Chat with ELI about this document — Q&A, summaries, explanations.
- Auto Emailer (tile): Compose Gmail draft to TP or requester from saved templates.
- Build Draft (tile): OARS-aware draft assembly + AI fill.
- Compare to Template (tile): Compare a draft against a stored template — surfaces deviations as a redline-style report.
- Data Hub (tile): Install / update / toggle / remove tools + data libraries.
- Defined Terms (tile): Every defined term with its definition, however it is marked - quoted, bold, italic, underlined or just capitalised. Flags terms defined twice, defined but never used, and used but never defined.
- DocuScrub (tile): Format Cleaner: Whitens fonts, flosses spacing, removes metadata.
- ELI Agent: Revise a contract from a plain-English instruction. Proposes edits you review one at a time, then applies them as tracked changes. Surfaced via the mode dropdown in Ask ELI's input.
- ELI Agent: Address Comments: Address Comments (Email-to-Redline) for ELI Agent: edits that answer an email or comment thread, and a reply. Installs and updates with ELI Agent.
- ELI Agent: Draft Document: Draft Document for ELI Agent: a guided interview, an outline, the drafted sections and their checks. Installs and updates with ELI Agent.
- ELI Agent: Respond: Respond to Redlines, Precedent and Before you send for ELI Agent. Installs and updates with ELI Agent.
- ELI Agent: Revise Document: Revise Document for ELI Agent: the plan, the review and the apply, and the engine Address Comments uses. Installs and updates with ELI Agent.
- ELI OS Update: Checks whether the ELI OS is behind the published build.
- ELI5 Explainer (tile): Simplifies complex documents for different audiences (age 10/14/18).
- Error Review (tile): AI proofread for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and footer cross-section consistency.
- Final Review (tile): Summarizes the agreement's key terms for the requester to approve before execution.
- Focus Flow (tile): Bionic reading format — bold the first N% of each word for faster eye anchoring.
- Guidance (tile): The team's negotiating rules — what we accept, what we push back on, and why. Feeds Review Redlines, Ask ELI and every other tool.
- Legal Review (tile): Configure + launch the high-fidelity review engine.
- Legal Risks: AI scan for risks + operational watchouts against your custom rules.
- My Draft History (tile): Every draft you've built with Build Draft — the recipe (template + Step 1 choices + Step 2 fills) so any can be recreated. Your data only.
- Personalize ELI: Customize your ELI mascot. Reached by clicking ELI in Ask ELI's welcome.
- Polish: Rewrite the selected text three ways — polished, plainer, formal — keeping the meaning identical.
- Redline Emails: Email generators for Review Redline — review summary, internal consent request, colleague-flag.
- Review Redlines (tile): Track-Port workbench — captures every tracked change in the doc, groups by clause, runs AI legal review per row.
- Template Searcher (tile): Find any word or phrase across every template in your library. Boolean operators (AND/OR/NOT), quoted phrases, parens for grouping. Highlights matches, groups by template + section.
- Text Helper (tile): Capture document text → AI-rewritten text draft with click-to-accept redline + selection regen.
- Training (tile): Guided training director — walk through ELI phase by phase.
- Trophy Gallery: Browse unlocked achievements + see what's still ahead.
- Usage Risks (tile): Commercial IT scan — extracts every operational constraint (SLAs, seat caps, rate limits, notice periods, audit terms) that governs how Colgate uses the product or service.
- Version History: Save and review document snapshots — travel with the file.
- What's New: The latest ELI release — new tools, improvements and fixes.

HOW-TO:
- How do I update ELI OS? ELI OS Update shows the steps when a new build is out: in Script Lab, delete the ELI snippet, choose Import, paste the link it gives, and run it. Tools, settings and trophies carry over. It takes about a minute and the document isn't touched.
- How do tool updates arrive? Tools update themselves from the ELI library when ELI starts. If one is waiting, Data Hub's Check for Updates installs it; Data Hub also turns tools on or off.
- Where is the Respond button? Respond is the gold button below Ask ELI's question box, with a badge counting the other side's tracked changes. It shows when the document holds changes from the other side; highlight some text first to answer only the changes in it. It answers each change (accept, counter or reject, with a reason) and nothing is written until you approve.
- How do I use Respond? Open a document with the other side's tracked changes and press the gold Respond button below Ask ELI's question box (or type "respond to the redlines in section 4"). Respond reads Colgate's positions, decides each change, and shows you every answer to change before anything is written into Word.
- How do I use Revise? Type what you want changed in Ask ELI, for example "make the confidentiality clause mutual". ELI reads it as a request, Revise plans the edits, you review each one, and it writes them as tracked changes.
- Headers, footers and footnotes Revise and Respond read the headers and footers too (Respond also footnotes); both are on by default. The switches are in Ask ELI's settings, Agents tab: "Include headers & footers" (Revise) and "Include headers, footers and footnotes" (Respond).
- How do I use Address Comments? Choose Address Comments under Mode in Ask ELI's settings, then paste the email or comment thread. It proposes the edits that answer each comment, shows the words behind each edit, and drafts a reply.
- How do I draft a new document? Ask ELI to draft it ("draft a services agreement for a marketing agency"). Draft Document asks a few questions, settles an outline, then drafts each part from the playbook and clause library. Build Draft, a dashboard tile, fills the team's own templates instead.
- Polish Highlight text in Word: the Polish button appears below Ask ELI's question box and offers three rewrites to compare (polished, plainer, formal), meaning unchanged.
- Ask ELI's settings Ask ELI's settings are the sliders icon in its top bar (pull the bar down with the small tab at the top right): answer length, follow-up suggestions, citation pins, progress steps, Colgate positions, and an Agents tab for Revise and Respond.
- The playbook and Colgate positions Ask ELI checks its answers against the EI Playbook's positions for the agreement type (and the team's rules), on by default. The greeting's EI Playbook seal shows how many positions and locks apply. The switch is "Use Colgate positions" in Ask ELI's settings.
- Ask about the team's templates Tap EI Templates in Ask ELI's greeting to attach the team's templates, all or the ones you pick, then ask across them ("which templates have a non-solicit?"). ELI sends the parts of them that answer each question. Detach with the × on the attachment.
- Attach a file Attach, in Ask ELI's question box, adds a PDF, Word or text file to ask about beside the document. Choose Live doc, Attachment or Both above the box.
- Clear the conversation Clear, in Ask ELI's top bar, wipes this chat. The document isn't touched.
- Change ELI's look Click ELI in Ask ELI's greeting to change its look.
- The API key ELI uses a Gemini API key, set once in ELI's Settings, Global. If answers fail with a key error, ask the ELI team for help. Never paste a key into a chat or an email.
- Where does my document go? To answer, ELI sends the document to Google's Gemini and nowhere else. ELI's logs and usage counts never include document content or questions.
- Undo something ELI wrote Everything ELI writes is a tracked change: reject it in Word's Review tab, or press Ctrl+Z straight after.

KNOWN ISSUES:
- Updates can take a while to arrive: The ELI library is served through a CDN that can keep an older copy for up to 12 hours, so a release may reach some computers later in the day. ELI OS Update checks two servers so a stale copy never hides a new build.
- Respond needs a recent Word: Respond answers the other side's changes one at a time, which needs a recent Microsoft 365 Word (Word API 1.6). On older Word it can't run; updating Office fixes it.
- Long documents: When Ask ELI opens it reads the whole document once, which can hold Word for a few seconds on a long agreement. Answers after that are quick.
- Word pauses while a tool opens: A tool's first opening in a session loads it, which can pause Word briefly. If one tool pauses Word every time, tell the ELI team which one."};
